global: This is Sugakiya’s spicy miso ramen, its broth a rich, orange-red hue. Topped with shredded cabbage, chili flakes, and a dark paste, it sits in a branded white bowl on a tray, under warm, even lighting.

regions.background: Light wooden table surface with visible grain, smooth texture, and warm tone beneath the bowl.
regions.bowl: White ceramic ramen bowl with brown "Sugakiya" logo and checkered pattern along its rim.
regions.soup: Miso ramen broth with noodles, garnished with shredded cabbage, chili flakes, and dark paste, appears rich and oily with visible noodle strands.
regions.spoon: A metallic spoon with a smooth, reflective surface and slightly curved, tapered shape.
